result.brief: 在病理图像低标签场景下对 SimCLR、BYOL 与 MAE 式掩码重建表征进行可靠性（校准、OOD 置信度）基准评测，属自监督视觉表征评估，但非视频/多模态世界模型。
result.reason: Benchmarks SSL (SimCLR/BYOL/MAE-style) frozen-encoder representations with calibration and OOD diagnostics, but in histopathology with no video/multimodal or generative latent contribution.
